chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
One who is in search of something will obtain it, at least a part of it.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and practical benefit of striving for a goal in Shia teachings?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes the principle of *al-mubalagha fi al-talab* (exertion in seeking), suggesting that the very act of striving ensures partial or complete attainment. This reflects the Shia understanding that effort is a divine catalyst for grace, where the journey itself yields spiritual and material rewards even if the ultimate goal remains elusive. It serves as a practical encouragement for believers to maintain persistent intention (*niyyah*) and action in their worldly and spiritual pursuits.
